The '''Bright Jewel Cluster''', also known as the '''Bright Jewel Systems Cluster''',<ref name="SWG:BEAv">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Journal Entry: "Black Envy: A virus?"</ref> was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region. It was administered by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]]-[[General/Legends|General]] [[Nox Vellam]]. Planets within the cluster included [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]]. Under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the cluster was part of [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]].
